levels.title: Level 1: Foundation
intro: Introduction to the principal tenets, key differentiation, therapeutic attitudes, and needs-based interventions.

body.text: Practitioners develop core skills including cultivating trust, transforming judgments into acceptance, empathic listening, and forging collaborative partnerships with clients.
Clients gain tools to connect with their heart's longings, access natural compassion, reduce reactivity, and request what they want cooperatively.
Each week alternates between conceptual learning and hands-on practice:
**When:** Tuesdays, 8:00–9:30 PM CT
**Duration:** 6 months — 24 sessions (Jan–Jun & Jul–Dec)
**Join anytime:** 1–4 catch-up sessions available for new participants
**Certificate:** Attend 20 of 24 sessions
**Group Size:** Max 25 participants
**Facilitators:** Myra Walden and Priti Sureka
*Empowerment Therapy* by Myra Walden — Chapters 2–5 covering Observations, Feelings, Needs, and Requests.
Recommended: Print Feelings and Needs inventories for use during sessions.
**$30–$50 USD/month** (sliding scale)
Fees remain low to help develop practitioners who will bring this work to people without access to support services.

levels.register: **How to enroll:** Email [empowermenttherapymw@gmail.com](mailto:empowermenttherapymw@gmail.com) to schedule a 45-minute assessment meeting with Myra Walden to determine goodness of fit.

levels.title: Level 2: Empowerment Processes
intro: Learning and application of Empowering Thoughts and Language — these are therapeutic processes that the practitioner can share with clients when pertinent, relevant and timely.
levels.note: *By studying some key concepts, people can take Level 2 before Level 1.

body.text: Receive direct feedback on your empowerment work while reviewing Level 1 concepts and learning powerful new therapeutic processes.
Certificate of completion for Level 1 is required (or studying key concepts to join concurrently).
**Duration:** 6 months of weekly sessions
**Facilitators:** Myra Walden and Priti Sureka
**$30–$50 USD/month** (sliding scale)
Fees remain low to help develop practitioners who will bring this work to people without access to support services.

levels.title: Level 3: Certification
intro: A year-long study to prepare for certification as a practitioner and, in some cases, as a trainer.

body.text: A mentorship program where participants transition to co-facilitator roles. The facilitator assigns explanations, presentations, Q&A sessions, and role plays while providing ongoing feedback.
**Prerequisites:** Completion of Levels 1 and 2
**Duration:** 50 sessions (may extend based on individual readiness)
**Facilitators:** Myra Walden, Simran Bhola, and Priti Sureka

items: *Nonviolent Communication: A Language of Life* by Marshall Rosenberg
*Personality Types: Using the Enneagram for Self-Discovery* by Don Richard Riso & Russ Hudson
**NVC Paper** — 20-page reaction paper on Rosenberg's book
**Enneagram Paper** — 8-page analysis of your type's integration-disintegration scale
**Session Recordings** — 5 recordings of 50-minute sessions with real (non-role-play) clients
**Self-Evaluations** — Assessment form for each recorded session
**Peer & Client Evaluations** — Feedback from facilitators, colleagues, and clients

body.text: Packet review takes approximately 3 months.
A 3-hour online meeting with 2–3 experienced assessors (recorded), including:

items: Guide Inner Silence Meditation from memory
Answer 15 questions on key differentiations, interventions, therapeutic attitudes, and principal tenets
Discuss the Actualizing Tendency and its relation to nondirectiveness
Conduct a Liberating Role Play demonstrating attitudes and concept application

body.text: Rubric-based grading provided at application. One retake attempt available if needed.
Based on your professional background:

items: **Mental health professionals:** Empowerment Therapist, Psychologist, Counselor, or Social Worker

body.text: Certification is valid for one year and renewable with 8 hours of continuing education. Trainer certification available as an additional track.
**Assessment fee:** $300–$450 USD (sliding scale)
**Annual renewal:** $50–$150 USD

levels.register: **To apply:** Email [empowermenttherapymw@gmail.com](mailto:empowermenttherapymw@gmail.com) — candidates must embody the therapeutic attitudes and demonstrate understanding and ability to apply the concepts.
